subject: Feeling any different?
body:
Don't be alarmed, but before you ever got here I had Grim give you a shot from a not so small syringe.

It's a formula I've been working on. Now that you've killed a creature, you can take its shape, and switch to any shape you've collected whenever you like. You even get the creatures' abilities!

I should have asked first. But you know what they say, better to ask for forgiveness than permission. And trust me, once you test this out, I won't need to ask for either.

Your old friend,
Dr. T

Controls: press [ or ] to open your forms, then Enter to pick one. Your normal self is at the top. Hold Alt and press F, G, V, C or X to use a form's abilities.
